title: E4 needs a github.com PR URL, so no run under adapter none reaches R1 to R7
root_cause: draft_pr_gate.py accepts only https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n>; cadence-core and the dev branch have no local PR record under adapter none

title: P4 plan update drops the RUN_BY_COMMAND: plan-create marker, and every later handoff is refused
root_cause: the plan-update peer rewrites the plan without the provenance marker that the handoff hook requires

title: A plan review written at another path is never counted, P4 is refused, and P9 passes anyway
root_cause: the P3 peer wrote .context/plans/<id>.plan-review.md, not .context/reviews/plan_<id>.plan.md; the rewrite was not counted as a plan-review peer write, and the P9 entry invariant does not check that the review counts

title: P7 fails three times and the orchestrator cannot read why
root_cause: the orchestrator-scope guard (ADR-0017) hides the P7 scorecard, and the gate message does not print the failing rows, so the plan update cannot target them

title: Delivered pipelines map the ticket's checks to invented invariants or file paths, so no check parses
root_cause: nothing in the core traces the ticket's own requirement list (the seven checks) to a delivered proof; the answer map is never run against the spec's contract before delivery

title: adapter none can be set only inside the plugin tree, so a clean benchmark run cannot use the local PR mode
root_cause: jtouley/cadence reads adapter only from the plugin root's cadence.config.json (shared/skill_gate.py load_adapter, scripts/tracker_header.py no_tracker_declared, scripts/preflight.py), which says github-issues; a project .cadence.json cannot set it, so turning on adapter none edits the plugin tree, which loop.driver refuses

title: On P2, Cadence on Haiku used 1.6 to 3.1 times the Haiku one-shot's agent time and still stopped before the end of the pipeline (a lower bound on the finished ratio; stretch goal: 1.25)
root_cause: time goes to planning loops before any code. Peer time per block from the attest logs (loop.blocks with start/stop pairing, postmortem 2026-10-21-cadence-core-subscription): plan-review 28 calls and plan-update 35 calls over the batch, 70 repeat calls in all; about 127 of 238 peer minutes were repeat rounds. P7 failed three times in two runs, and the third replanned from scratch after E1

title: The P9 entry gate counted every MF-n named anywhere in the plan review as open, so the plan could never satisfy it
root_cause: the fifth review listed three open items under Must-fix and named seven earlier ids elsewhere (applied, notes, found sound); the P9 gate read all ten as open, three plan updates mapped the three open ones, and the run hit a retries hard stop with no code. Fixed on the old jtouley/cadence branch at f6011df (the gate reads only the review's must-fix section) with no Finding trailer; whether cadence main carries it is UNPROVEN until a re-measure

title: `/cadence <spec path>` is not an entry: the documented first action exits 1 in a fresh task repository on main (Cannot determine task ID)
root_cause: SKILL.md's first action is `activate_session.py --from-branch --fresh --supersede`; on `main` with no ticket it derives no task id and exits 1 with `ERROR: Cannot determine task ID. Provide --task-id, --task-desc, or --from-branch` (stub run 20261023-stub-f9-entry-fresh-repo on cadence c458a46, a fresh repository with one commit). SKILL.md never reads a spec path or $ARGUMENTS, and there is no commands/cadence.md: the entry is free text (README.md, `/cadence Add monthly budgets ... Ticket #12.`). The Oct 21 runs did not hit it only because the harness wrapped the ticket in a drive prompt that named the task id, the branch and the PR file (frameworks.lock.json drive_prompt and host_trial.sh at d8b9611, run 20261021-P1-cadence-core-haiku-1), so they were not spec-only runs.

title: Git hooks in a worktree pass their absolute GIT_DIR to tests that build their own repositories: the tests write into the worktree's repository and flip its core.bare to true
root_cause: a git hook in a linked worktree runs with GIT_DIR (and GIT_INDEX_FILE) set to absolute paths into <repo>/.git/worktrees/<name>. Tests that run `git init <tmp>` inherit it, so git reinitialises that repository, not <tmp>, and sets core.bare=true on it. Stub run 20261023-stub-f10-hook-env-core-bare (cadence c458a46): tests/contract/test_ste_writing_contract.py run under a worktree's GIT_DIR passed (9 tests) and left core.bare false -> true on the owning repository. Hit twice for real on 2026-10-22/23 (the pre-push ci_local run: 1056 failed, 325 errors; then a pre-commit contract-tests run, after which core.bare read true). Fix in progress on jtouley/cadence#202: ci_local.sh unsets `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` (4b098d7, test 8c78bbf), and tests/conftest.py `_hermetic_git` drops the same names for every test (87fb0ac, the second review).
